findings.description: L06 can overclaim parity by trusting existing coverage_matrix/report views instead of revalidating source artifacts for each small-real surface.

findings.safeguard: Require an artifact-level parity audit that joins each L06 surface to source artifact paths, schema validation results, source hashes, producer names, run IDs, value status, and report classification.

findings.description: Fake or skipped evidence can be misclassified as real small-real Valkey proof, especially for P07/P08 where data-path probes are intentionally skipped during fault/failover wrappers.

P07 valkey_e2e_evidence.json is produced by scripts/fault_safety_gate.py with real_valkey=true, Valkey 9.1.0, nodes_observed=6, cluster_state_observed=ok, but data_path_result=SKIPPED_WITH_REASON.

findings.blocker_condition: Any L06 artifact or report that treats fake tests, skipped data-path probes, generated logs, or static files as equivalent to real wrapper evidence is a blocker.
findings.safeguard: For each surface, require producer allowlists and semantic checks: valkey_e2e_gate.py for normal small-real scenarios, fault_safety_gate.py for fault sandbox, fault_failover_gate.py for failover, plus explicit skipped reason preservation.

findings.description: Fresh real-gate validation can fail due to Docker/Valkey resource constraints; static artifacts alone should not be used to claim fresh evidence when the L06 harness requires freshness.

findings.blocker_condition: If L06 design requires fresh six-node real gates and Docker/Valkey resources are unavailable or cleanup cannot be proven, the stage must be BLOCKED rather than passed from stale committed artifacts.
findings.safeguard: Separate committed-artifact parity audit from fresh real-gate smoke validation; when fresh gates are required, record resource preflight, wrapper command logs, evidence paths, and deterministic cleanup before PASS.

findings.description: Host-network safety can regress if fault sandbox or failover validation uses sudo, host firewall/routing tools, host interfaces, or unrelated process kills.
evidence: AGENTS.md forbids physical host network configuration changes and global firewall/routing/interface mutation.
P07 fault_apply.json and fault_report.json record host_network_mutated=false, global_firewall_mutated=false, sandbox_only=true, and scope=container_namespace_or_sandbox_proxy.
P08 fault_report.json records node_stop scoped to owned_container_or_process and safety_checks host_network_mutated=false, global_firewall_mutated=false, sandbox_only=true.
findings.blocker_condition: Any L06 fault/failover harness, source code change, command, or artifact that mutates host network/firewall/routing/interfaces or kills unrelated host processes is a blocker.
findings.safeguard: Run safety_scan.py, validate P07/P08 safety_check fields, require owned container/process or sandbox proxy scopes, and require cleanup residual checks after fault/failover validation.

findings.description: Split-brain metrics are not measured by the current primary-stop gate and must remain explicit MISSING, not converted to zero or PASS.

findings.blocker_condition: Any L06 extraction, report, or visualization that turns missing split-brain duration into 0, PASS, measured false safety, or omits the missing reason is a blocker.
findings.safeguard: Require report classifications for MEASURED, MISSING, SKIPPED_WITH_REASON, and NO_BASELINE_YET, and include a regression test for P08 split_brain_duration_ms missing semantics.

acceptance_criteria: L06 source-of-truth checks validate P03-P11 machine-readable artifacts directly and do not depend on rendered report files.
Every L06 real surface has a source artifact, schema validation result, producer, run_id, source hash, status, and metric extraction entry.

Real evidence is accepted only from the appropriate wrapper producer with real_valkey=true, Valkey version prefix 9.1., expected node count, cluster state, cleanup PASS, and data-path PASS or an explicit fault/failover SKIPPED_WITH_REASON.
P07 and P08 safety checks prove host_network_mutated=false, global_firewall_mutated=false, sandbox_only=true, and owned-container/sandbox scope.
P08 split_brain_duration_ms remains MISSING with reason not_measured_by_primary_stop_gate until a real split-brain/partition scenario measures it.
Reports and visualizations distinguish MEASURED, MISSING, SKIPPED_WITH_REASON, and NO_BASELINE_YET values.
P14 remains opt-in dry-run only and is not run, counted as real coverage, or used as an L06 resource target.
If fresh real six-node gates are required, resource unavailability or cleanup failure blocks L06 rather than falling back to stale committed evidence.
No source code, tests, schemas, scripts, manifest, workflow, or historical gate artifacts are weakened or modified by this risk-auditor task.
risks: Existing coverage reports can make L06 appear complete without artifact-level parity validation.
P07/P08 fault-specific SKIPPED_WITH_REASON data-path results can be mistaken for normal data-path PASS evidence.
Rendered reports can accidentally become metric inputs and hide missing source values.
P14 or P02 1000-node dry-run planner artifacts can be misread as real 1000-node or L06 evidence.
Fresh six-node real gates may be resource-constrained; passing from static artifacts would be unsafe if freshness is required.
Fault and failover validation can regress into host-network mutation if safety guards are not checked.
Split-brain duration is currently unmeasured and must not be fabricated.
Harness controls can be weakened by relaxing schemas, deleting tests, lowering real evidence requirements, or editing historical artifacts.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not modify source code or tests for this risk-auditor task.
Do not run P14_SCALE_1000_OPTIN_DRYRUN or set VSLAB_ALLOW_1000_DRYRUN.
Do not count P02 or P14 1000 dry-run artifacts as real Valkey evidence.
Do not use rendered HTML, Markdown, SVG, or CSV reports as source-of-truth for L06 metrics.
Do not convert MISSING, SKIPPED_WITH_REASON, or NO_BASELINE_YET values into zero, PASS, or measured values.
Do not mutate host firewall, routing, PF, nftables, iptables, host interfaces, or OS network services.
Do not use sudo or kill unrelated host processes for fault/failover validation.
Do not handwrite PASS into gate, audit, validation, or report artifacts.
Do not weaken schemas, tests, CI workflows, phase manifest requirements, or historical gate evidence to pass L06.
notes: APPROVED because the identified high risks have clear, testable mitigations and no unresolved blocker is present in this read-only risk audit. Approval is conditional on L06 staying artifact-first, preserving P07/P08 safety and missing semantics, not running or reclassifying P14, blocking rather than passing when fresh real-gate resources are unavailable, and preventing any harness weakening.
